title: Length bound for a split step
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be finite Boolean sequences, and suppose that the length of $s$ is at most the length of $w$ plus one. Form a new sequence by appending $	exttt{true}$ to $s$ if the length of $s$ is at most the length of $w$, and otherwise leaving $s$ unchanged. The resulting sequence has length at most the length of $w$ plus one.
hypotheses_covered: The length of $s$ is at most the length of $w$ plus one
